mdas.name: Abuja Geographic Information Systems / FCT Lands
mdas.description: AGIS is the FCT land-information and land-administration channel used for allocation, title search, consent, registration and related property transactions.

officialChannels.name: AGIS Services & Payment Procedure
officialChannels.instructions: Obtain the correct AGIS bill first. Follow the official AGIS payment procedure and use the FCT/AGIS Remita route specified by AGIS. Do not pay an unofficial agent.

services.name: New land application - commercial/residential plot

evidence.title: AGIS processes and payment requirements
evidence.notes: Official AGIS process and payment requirements support the stated new land application fee.

services.paymentGuide: Complete the official application process, obtain the AGIS bill, pay through the official AGIS/Remita procedure, and submit the required payment evidence with the application.

services.name: Land title search - private/individual file

evidence.title: AGIS processes and payment requirements
evidence.notes: Official AGIS process and payment requirements support the stated private or individual title-search fee.

services.paymentGuide: Obtain the title-search bill from AGIS and pay using the official AGIS payment procedure.

services.name: Land title search - commercial/organisational file

evidence.title: AGIS processes and payment requirements
evidence.notes: Official AGIS process and payment requirements support the stated commercial or organisational title-search fee.

services.paymentGuide: Obtain the commercial or organisational title-search bill from AGIS and pay using the official AGIS payment procedure.

services.name: Power of Attorney registration

evidence.title: AGIS title registration requirements
evidence.notes: Official AGIS title-registration requirements publish the Power of Attorney fee formula.

services.paymentGuide: Follow the title-registration requirements, obtain the official bill, and pay through the official AGIS payment procedure.

services.name: Deed of Assignment / Gift

evidence.title: AGIS title registration requirements
evidence.notes: AGIS assesses this charge as 8% of property value; the property value and resulting amount must be assessed officially.

services.paymentGuide: AGIS assesses this charge from the property value. Obtain the official assessment before payment.

services.name: Deed of Sublease
services.formula: 2% of consideration + ₦10,000 consent + ₦10,000 processing + ₦2,000 counterpart copy

evidence.title: AGIS title registration requirements
evidence.notes: Official AGIS title-registration requirements publish the Deed of Sublease component formula.

services.paymentGuide: Obtain the official assessed bill. Preserve each component separately rather than representing a universal fixed total.

services.name: Consent to legal mortgage
services.formula: 1% of consideration + ₦10,000 consent + ₦10,000 processing + ₦2,000 counterpart copy

evidence.title: AGIS title registration requirements
evidence.notes: Official AGIS title-registration requirements publish the legal-mortgage consent component formula.

services.paymentGuide: Obtain the official assessed bill. Preserve each component separately.

services.name: Late recertification of FCC title

evidence.title: AGIS processes and payment requirements
evidence.notes: Official AGIS process and payment requirements support the late FCC title recertification fee.

services.paymentGuide: Obtain the official AGIS bill and pay through the official AGIS payment procedure.

services.name: Area Council regularisation exercise

evidence.title: AGIS processes and payment requirements
evidence.notes: Official AGIS process and payment requirements support the Area Council regularisation fee.

services.paymentGuide: Obtain the official AGIS bill and pay through the official AGIS payment procedure.

mdas.name: High Court of the Federal Capital Territory
mdas.description: Affidavits are frequently required for identity, banking, education, employment and administrative processes. The court's VARMS platform publishes walk-in and virtual affidavit prices and provides the application workflow.

officialChannels.name: FCT High Court VARMS
officialChannels.instructions: Start the affidavit on the official VARMS platform, choose the appropriate route, pay within the official system, complete the form, and follow the Commissioner for Oaths process.

services.name: Walk-in affidavit

evidence.title: FCT High Court VARMS portal
evidence.publisher: High Court of the Federal Capital Territory
evidence.notes: The official VARMS portal publishes the walk-in affidavit price.

services.paymentGuide: Start the affidavit on VARMS and select the walk-in option. Pay only the amount generated by the official platform.

services.name: Virtual affidavit

evidence.title: FCT High Court VARMS portal
evidence.publisher: High Court of the Federal Capital Territory
evidence.notes: The official VARMS portal publishes the virtual affidavit price as all-inclusive.

services.paymentGuide: Start the affidavit on VARMS, select the virtual option, pay online, complete the affidavit process and attend the required review with the Commissioner for Oaths.

mdas.name: National Population Commission
mdas.description: Birth registration and attestation are foundational civil-registration services. FeeLens must distinguish free centre-based registration from paid digital self-service services.

officialChannels.name: NPC Digital Services
officialChannels.instructions: Start from the official NPC website and use the appropriate official civil-registration service. Where an online self-service portal is used, pay only through that official portal.

services.name: Birth registration for child under 5 at NPC registration centre

evidence.title: NPC birth registration statement for the first baby of 2025
evidence.notes: The official statement publishes centre-based birth registration for an eligible child under five as free; the source is dated 2025 without an exact publication day in the research record.

services.paymentGuide: Centre-based registration for an eligible child under five is published as free. Use an NPC registration centre or official NPC channel.

services.name: Online self-service birth registration

evidence.title: NPC birth registration self-service portal
evidence.notes: The official NPC self-service portal publishes the online birth-registration charge in USD.

services.paymentGuide: Create or sign in to the official self-service portal, complete the registration details and pay the published portal charge. Keep the official amount in USD; do not convert it to NGN.

services.name: Adult Certificate of Birth (Attestation) self-service

evidence.title: NPC attestation portal
evidence.notes: The official NPC attestation portal publishes the adult Certificate of Birth self-service charge in USD.

services.paymentGuide: Use the official NPC attestation portal, complete identity/NIN requirements and pay only through the official portal. Keep the published amount in USD.

mdas.name: Joint Admissions and Matriculation Board
mdas.description: JAMB registration and post-registration services affect a large student population in Abuja/FCT. Official JAMB materials publish registration and correction-service charges.

officialChannels.name: JAMB e-Facility
officialChannels.instructions: Sign in to the official JAMB e-Facility, select the required service, generate the transaction/payment instruction, pay using the official workflow, and use an approved CBT centre only where required.

services.name: 2026 Direct Entry registration

evidence.title: JAMB 2026 official bulletin
evidence.notes: The official JAMB bulletin dated 2 March 2026 publishes the Direct Entry registration fee.

services.paymentGuide: Sign in to the official JAMB e-Facility, select Direct Entry registration, generate the transaction and pay using the official workflow.

services.name: 2026 UTME registration without mock

evidence.title: JAMB 2026 official bulletin
evidence.notes: The official JAMB bulletin dated 2 March 2026 publishes the UTME registration fee without mock.

services.paymentGuide: Sign in to the official JAMB e-Facility, select UTME registration without mock, generate the transaction and pay using the official workflow.

services.name: 2026 UTME registration with mock

evidence.title: JAMB 2026 official bulletin
evidence.notes: The official JAMB bulletin dated 2 March 2026 publishes the UTME registration fee with mock.

services.paymentGuide: Sign in to the official JAMB e-Facility, select UTME registration with mock, generate the transaction and pay using the official workflow.

services.name: Correction of data - institution/course, name, DOB, state/LGA, gender, A-level qualification

evidence.title: JAMB official payment services page
evidence.notes: The official payment-services page lists ₦2,500 per listed correction service. Any separately listed CBT service charge remains separate.

services.paymentGuide: Sign in to e-Facility, select the correction service, generate the transaction and pay through the official JAMB workflow. Do not combine any CBT service charge into the statutory/service fee unless the official source does so.

services.name: Printing of result slip

evidence.title: JAMB official payment services page
evidence.notes: Current official JAMB Payment & Services page lists JAMB Result Slip at ₦1,000 with a separate ₦100 CBT service charge.

evidence.title: JAMB 2025 Training Manual
evidence.notes: Official JAMB 2025 Training Manual lists Printing of Result Slip (Coloured) at ₦1,500, with a separate service charge of ₦200 at PRC/PTC or ₦300 at non-JAMB centres.

services.paymentGuide: Official JAMB sources currently disagree on the result-slip portal charge. FeeLens therefore does not present one amount as authoritative. Confirm the amount currently displayed by JAMB e-Facility before making payment.
